exposure: medically treated postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) management techniques
cohort: 83 women who presented with medically treated postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) between January and December 2021.
finding: Mild uterine synechiae were observed in 24% of women at 12 weeks postpartum, with second manual uterine examination and bimanual uterine massage identified as independent risk factors for synechiae formation.
